slides.s: PMP-Certified Engineering Manager | 20+ Years Driving Enterprise Software & AI-Enabled Transformation
slides.n: Welcome to {name}'s career showcase. With over two decades in software engineering and eight-plus years leading engineering teams, {he} has built a reputation for delivering enterprise-scale products and pioneering AI-driven engineering practices.

items: F5 Innovation India · Jul 2025-Sep 2026 — Led control-plane teams on BIG-IP LTM/APM, drove multifactor authentication development, reduced upgrade time ~90%, and led security hardening that cut 100+ long-lived CVEs/defects.

Cisco Systems India · Mar 2020-Jul 2025 — Led Webex developer experience team, architected AWS-hosted distributed services integrating Webex Calling/Meetings with Microsoft Teams using Kafka, Redis, TypeScript/React and Java.

Cisco Systems India · Apr 2018-Feb 2020 — Led Cisco Expressway VoIP gateway development and release/CI-CD engineering using Jenkins, Kubernetes, Docker, OpenStack; delivered 10+ major and 30+ minor releases.

Cisco Systems India · Apr 2008-Feb 2018 — Led QA and Python-based test automation for Cisco Call Manager and Expressway, mentoring QA teams and driving Agile adoption and customer escalation resolution.
Verizon India & Alcatel India · 2007-2008 — Performed end-to-end call-flow and regression testing for IP contact center and PBX solutions, covering IVR, routing, and PSTN/VoIP integration.
slides.n: {His} path spans from hands-on QA engineering to leading cutting-edge engineering teams at Cisco and F5, consistently taking on greater scope—from test automation to architecting distributed cloud services and driving AI-first engineering transformation.

{Name}'s technical foundation runs deep—from distributed systems and cloud-native DevOps to pioneering applications of Agentic AI and large language models for engineering productivity and security remediation.

These numbers reflect real outcomes—from slashing upgrade times by nearly ninety percent to resolving over a hundred long-standing customer defects and security vulnerabilities, all while managing dozens of successful product releases.

{His} academic journey includes a foundational engineering degree complemented by a recent postgraduate program in Artificial Intelligence from UT Austin, underscoring {his} commitment to staying at the forefront of technology.

Thank you for exploring {name}'s journey—a story of continuous growth from QA engineering to engineering leadership, now driving the future of AI-enabled software development. {He} looks forward to connecting with you.
